items.titleEn: Fleetwood Town drawn in Carabao Cup fourth round
items.summaryEn: We will face the League Two side in the next round of the competition
bodyEn: We have been drawn against Fleetwood Town in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup, with the tie to take place at the League Two side's Highbury Stadium.

Having beaten Ipswich Town 4-2 at Portman Road on Tuesday night to advance in the competition, the draw for the next round has pitted us against the Fishermen, with the game scheduled for the week commencing October 26. It will be the first-ever meeting between the sides in competitive action.

Fleetwood reached this stage by beating fellow fourth-tier opposition Chesterfield and Shrewsbury Town, before then knocking out Championship side Sheffield United in the third round. All of their ties have been held at their 5,300-capacity home in the north-west.

We reached the final last season before Manchester City pipped us to the silverware at Wembley, missing out on having our name engraved on the trophy for a third time, with our two successes coming in 1987 and 1993.
Exact dates and kick-off times, plus ticket information, will be announced in due course.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳在联赛杯第四轮抽中弗利特伍德镇
items.summaryZh: 我们在联赛杯下一轮将对阵这支英乙球队。
bodyZh: 我们在联赛杯第四轮抽中了弗利特伍德镇，比赛将在该英乙球队的高地伯里球场进行。
周二晚上我们在波特曼路球场以4比2击败伊普斯维奇晋级后，下一轮抽签让我们对阵这支渔夫军团，比赛定于10月26日所在的那周进行。这将是双方在正式比赛中的首次交锋。
弗利特伍德在此之前击败了同级别对手切斯特菲尔德和什鲁斯伯里，随后在第三轮淘汰了英冠球队谢菲尔德联。他们所有的比赛都在其位于西北部、容量为5300人的主场举行。
我们上赛季杀入决赛，但在温布利被曼城击败错失冠军，未能第三次将队名刻在奖杯上，我们之前的两次成功分别是在1987年和1993年。
确切的比赛日期、开球时间以及票务信息将在随后公布。

bodyEn: Mikel Merino says Max Dowman reminds him of Lamine Yamal after the Arsenal prodigy continued his development by scoring twice in his side’s 4-2 win against Ipswich.

Dowman, who has been given a host of opportunities at senior level by Mikel Arteta, starred after being handed his first appearance of the season, at Portman Road on Tuesday. The 16-year-old attacker’s classy double eased Arsenal into the last 16 of the Carabao Cup and left Arteta admitting that containing the hype around the England youth international is not an easy task.

Arsenal are managing Dowman carefully and Merino is well placed to see how young talents can benefit from listening to managers and older players. The Arsenal midfielder plays with Lamine Yamal for Spain and believes Dowman is as fearless as the 19-year-old winger.

“There are some similarities in terms of their character,” he said. “They don’t care about the spotlight. They thrive when pressure is at the highest. They are always up for the challenge and they are not shy at all – even facing the biggest names in the game.”

Merino, who also scored against Ipswich, raved about Dowman. “He is an unbelievable talent. We knew it, but every time he goes on the pitch and plays against grown men he makes the difference. He is a big talent and we have to take care of him.

“We have to keep pushing him. He needs to keep learning – eyes and ears open always. There is still big room for improvement in a lot of areas and he knows that. So we are going to be by his side trying to get him to his best level.

“It is a thin line. It is very difficult to have equilibrium sometimes with him, because obviously you want him to shine and show everyone the talent that he has. But you have to sometimes remind them that they are human beings and they are part of a bigger squad and team.

“The good thing with these kind of players – Lamine and Max – is that they are special talents, but at the same time they are very humble. They are always keen to learn and listen to the veterans. That is priceless.”

Merino also praised Marli Salmon after the 17-year-old impressed against Ipswich. “In that position as a centre-back, you need to be very mature,” he said.

“It’s very important you don’t make many mistakes. Every action is crucial. It’s the same as with Max, he is an unbelievable talent. We try to teach them our experience and they are very good at listening.”

items.titleZh: 梅里诺：阿森纳新星道曼让我想起了亚马尔
items.summaryZh: 道曼在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中独中两元，梅里诺称赞他是位极具天赋的球员。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳以4-2战胜伊普斯威奇的比赛中，天才小将道曼梅开二度，继续着他的成长轨迹，米克尔·梅里诺表示这让他想起了亚马尔。
道曼在周二的波特曼路球场迎来了本赛季的首次登场并大放异彩，米克尔·阿尔特塔此前已在成年队比赛中给了他许多出场机会。这位16岁攻击手的精彩双响帮助阿森纳轻松晋级联赛杯16强，这也让阿尔特塔承认，控制外界对这位英格兰青年国脚的炒作并非易事。
阿森纳正在谨慎地培养道曼，而梅里诺很清楚年轻才俊如何能从听取教练和老队员的意见中受益。这位阿森纳中场与亚马尔在西班牙国家队并肩作战，他认为道曼和这位19岁的边锋一样无所畏惧。
“他们在性格上有相似之处，”他说。“他们不在乎聚光灯。当压力达到顶峰时，他们反而能茁壮成长。他们总是勇于迎接挑战，而且一点也不害羞——即使面对比赛中最大牌的球星也是如此。”
同样在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中取得进球的梅里诺对道曼赞不绝口。“他是一个不可思议的天才。我们早就知道这一点，但每次他上场与成年人对抗时，他都能改变比赛。他是一个巨大的天才，我们必须照顾好他。”
“我们必须继续推动他。他需要不断学习——时刻保持眼观六路、耳听八方。在许多方面仍有很大的改进空间，他也很清楚这一点。所以我们会站在他身边，努力让他达到最佳水平。”
“这是一条微妙的界限。有时很难在他身上保持平衡，因为你显然希望他发光并向所有人展示他的天赋。但你有时必须提醒他们，他们是人类，他们是一个更大的阵容和团队的一部分。”
“这类球员的好处——无论是亚马尔还是马克思（道曼），他们都是特殊的天才，但与此同时他们也非常谦逊。他们总是热衷于学习并倾听老将们的教诲。这是无价的。”

梅里诺还称赞了马尔利·萨尔蒙，这位17岁小将在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中表现亮眼。“在那个中后卫的位置上，你需要非常成熟，”他说。
“不犯太多错误非常重要。每一个动作都至关重要。就像马克思一样，他是一个不可思议的天才。我们试图将我们的经验传授给他们，他们非常善于倾听。”

items.titleEn: Magic Max: The best of Dowman at Ipswich
items.summaryEn: It was another night to remember for the 16-year-old at Portman Road - watch his best moments from the game
bodyEn: We began our Carabao Cup journey on Tuesday night with a thrilling 4-2 win at Ipswich Town, and Max Dowman delivered another Player of the Match display.
After firing a brace at Portman Road, including an exquisite opener inside just seven minutes, Max joined several former Arsenal stars in an elite club to score in the competition aged 16.
These include Cesc Fabregas - who netted the last of a 5-1 victory against Wolverhampton Wanderers back in 2003 - and Jack Wilshere, following his effort in a 6-0 rout of Sheffield United in 2008.

Already the Premier League's youngest-ever goalscorer thanks to his memorable late moment against Everton last March, Dowman now joins Wayne Rooney - then of the Toffees back in 2002 - as the only 16-year-olds to net twice for a Premier League club in any competitive match.

It was the teenager's first start of 2026/27, handed to him by Mikel Arteta as both he and fellow prospect Marli Salmon each played the full 90 minutes in Suffolk. Max now has 14 senior appearances in an Arsenal shirt, with three goals.

In a triumphant night for Hale End, not only did Dowman, Salmon and the ever-impressive Myles Lewis-Skelly all complete the full match, but there was a competitive debut off the bench for 18-year-old Theo Julienne - who supporters may recall from facing Fabregas' Como in pre-season - and later Ife Ibrahim, also 18, who debuted against Kairat Almaty in the Champions League last campaign.

items.titleZh: 神奇马克斯：道曼在对阵伊普斯维奇时的精彩表现
items.summaryZh: 16岁的道曼在对阵伊普斯维奇的比赛中表现出色，贡献全场最佳发挥。
bodyZh: 我们在周二晚上的英格兰联赛杯征程中以4-2的比分在客场击败伊普斯维奇，取得了一场惊心动魄的胜利，马克斯·道曼再次奉献了全场最佳的表现。
在波特曼路球场打进两球（包括开场仅七分钟时的精彩首开纪录）后，马克斯加入了几位前阿森纳球星的精英行列，成为在16岁时就在该赛事中进球的球员。
其中包括法布雷加斯——他在2003年5-1战胜狼队的比赛中攻入了最后一球，以及杰克·威尔希尔，他在2008年6-0大胜谢菲尔德联队的比赛中有过进球。
凭借去年三月对阵埃弗顿时的难忘时刻，道曼已经成为了英超历史上最年轻的进球者。如今，他又比肩鲁尼（当时效力于埃弗顿，时间是2002年），成为了仅有的在任何正式比赛中为英超俱乐部单场打入两球的16岁球员。
这是这位少年在2026/27赛季的首次先发，由米克尔·阿尔特塔安排他出场，他和另一位希望之星马尔利·萨尔蒙都在萨福克郡踢满了全场90分钟。马克斯目前已经代表阿森纳一线队出场14次，打入3球。
对青训营（Hale End）而言这是一个凯旋之夜，不仅道曼、萨尔蒙和表现抢眼的迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利都打满了整场比赛，18岁的西奥·朱利安也在替补席上迎来了自己的一线队正式首秀——球迷们或许还记得他在季前赛中对阵法布雷加斯的科莫时的表现，随后同样18岁的伊费·易卜拉欣也替补登场，他上赛季曾在对阵阿拉木图凯拉特的欧冠比赛中上演首秀。
你现在可以通过上方的视频欣赏马克斯对阵伊普斯维奇时的精湛表现，下方则是我们在波特曼路球场收获全部六个进球的集锦。

bodyEn: We extended our winning start to the season with a 4-2 win over Ipswich Town in the Carabao Cup, and you can see how Mikel Arteta and his coaching staff reacted to the best moments of the game with Bench Cam.

items.titleEn: The 123-year club record we could equal at Brighton
items.summaryEn: Find out the piece of club history we could make against Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday
bodyEn: Our blistering start to the 2026/27 season saw us pick up a seventh straight victory after knocking Ipswich Town out of the Carabao Cup, putting us on the brink of a club record.

After maintaining a 100% record in our four Premier League outings, winning the Community Shield, beating Napoli in our Champions League opener and advancing in the League Cup at Portman Road, things have gone perfectly for us since we kicked off the season with a 3-0 win against Manchester City in Cardiff.
And should we beat Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday to keep our winning run intact going into the international break, we’ll match our longest winning start to a season, set 123 years ago.

Back in 1903/04, Woolwich Arsenal were playing in the Second Division and began the campaign on fire, winning all of their first eight matches, including a pair of 8-0 successes over Burton United and Leicester Fosse, and beating Manchester United 4-0.

That remains our best start to a season in all competitions, but Mikel Arteta’s class of 2026 could emulate those feats with a victory at the Amex Stadium. They have already matched our second-best effort, which came much more recently in 2004/05, when the Invincibles marched on by winning the first seven games of that campaign before a 2-2 draw against Bolton Wanderers in game eight.
Our best winning starts to a season (all comps)

Only in five other seasons have we won our first five league games, but Mikel is the only boss to have done it twice, having also started the 2022/23 season with a 100% record. The 1947/48 campaign is the only top-flight campaign where we reached six wins at the start of a league campaign, meaning we can also match that feat this weekend.
And when you take into account the five successive victories that took us to title glory last season, we're heading to the south coast this weekend on the back of nine straight Premier League wins.

That is our best winning stretch in the league since March 2004 when Arsene Wenger’s men also hit nine in a row. We've hit double figures only three times before; the first came back in November 1987 under George Graham when we won 10 First Division matches in succession. This stretch also included four League Cup victories, with the 14 successive wins marking our longest winning run across all competitions in our history.

We also hit 10 straight league victories between March and May 1998 as Wenger steered us to his first English title, however we still have some way to go to beat our club record of 14 successive league wins, which was achieved during the conclusion of the 2001/02 double-winning campaign, as well as the first few weeks of the following season.

items.titleZh: 我们在对阵布莱顿的比赛中可能追平一项123年的俱乐部纪录
items.summaryZh: 若周六击败布莱顿，阿森纳将追平123年前创下的赛季开局连胜纪录。
bodyZh: 我们在2026/27赛季开局势头强劲，在联赛杯中淘汰伊普斯维奇后取得了七连胜，这也让我们距离一项俱乐部纪录仅一步之遥。
在保持英超四战全胜、赢得社区盾杯、在欧冠首战击败那不勒斯以及在波特曼路晋级联赛杯之后，自从我们在加的夫以3-0击败曼城开启新赛季以来，一切都进行得非常完美。
如果我们在周六击败布莱顿并在进入国际比赛日之前保持连胜势头，我们将追平123年前创下的队史最佳赛季开局连胜纪录。
早在1903/04赛季，当时名为伍尔维奇阿森纳的俱乐部还在乙级联赛效力，他们在赛季初状态火热，赢得了前八场比赛的全部胜利，其中包括两场以8-0大胜伯顿联和莱斯特福斯，以及以4-0击败曼联。
这依然是我们各项赛事最佳的赛季开局，但米克尔·阿尔特塔率领的2026届子弟兵有望在美加体育场的胜利中复制这一壮举。他们已经追平了我们在2004/05赛季创造的队史第二佳战绩，当时“不败之师”在那个赛季的前七场比赛中全部获胜，直到第八场以2-2战平博尔顿流浪者。
我们的赛季最佳开局连胜纪录（所有赛事）
只有在另外五个赛季里，我们才赢得了前五场联赛，但米克尔是唯一一位两次做到这一点的教练，他在2022/23赛季也曾取得过全胜开局。1947/48赛季是我们唯一一次在顶级联赛开局取得六连胜的赛季，这意味着我们本周末也有望追平这一壮举。
当你考虑到上赛季带给我们联赛冠军的五连胜时，我们本周末前往南部海岸时正带着英超九连胜的傲人战绩。
这是我们自2004年3月温格麾下的球队取得九连胜以来，在联赛中最好的连胜势头。我们此前仅有三次达成过联赛双位数连胜；第一次是在1987年11月，在乔治·格雷厄姆的率领下，我们连续赢下了10场甲级联赛。这段期间还包括四场联赛杯胜利，这14场连续胜利成为了我们队史各项赛事中最长的连胜纪录。
在温格带领我们夺得他的首个英格兰顶级联赛冠军期间，我们还在1998年3月至5月之间取得了联赛10连胜，不过要打破我们在2001/02双冠王赛季末期以及随后赛季初创造的14场联赛连胜纪录，我们还有一段路要走。

items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners came from behind to secure three points in the EFL Trophy
bodyEn: Our under-21s delivered their best performance of the season so far to overturn an early deficit and beat Leyton Orient 2-1 in the EFL Trophy.
Nicholas Oyekunle had given the O's the lead with a deft header following a set-piece routine, but Archie Stevens equalised with a fantastic finish on a tight angle.

We had plenty of defending to do in the second half as the League One side pushed to regain their lead, but it was our young Gunners who got the decisive goal when Evan Mooney's shot was parried out to Andre Harriman-Annous, who made no mistake from close range.
Press play on the video at the top of the article to see how we got over the line in east London.

items.summaryZh: 年轻的枪手在 EFL 杯中逆转取胜，全取三分。

由于这支英甲球队在下半场全力争胜，我们面临了巨大的防守压力，但最终是我们的年轻枪手打入了制胜球：埃文·穆尼的射门被扑出，安德雷·哈里曼-阿努斯近距离补射命中。

items.summaryEn: Mikel reflects on our win, Max Dowman and Marli Salmon after our win at Ipswich
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta described Max Dowman's performance as unbelievable as the teenager grabbed two goals in a 4-2 victory over Ipswich Town in the Carabao Cup.
The 16-year-old became our second youngest scorer in the competition's history when he netted inside 10 minutes, before scoring inside 90 seconds of the second half kicking off.
Speaking about Max's display, he said: "He was unbelievable again; some of the actions and connections that he can give us on the pitch are just a joy to watch.
"He was really efficient; he’s getting more and more active in action; he can sustain for longer periods, and we know the talent that we have."
Max wasn't the only teenager starting, as Marli Salmon enjoyed a composed 90 minutes in the six-goal thriller at Portman Road.

On Salmon's display, he said: "Really good as well, and it was a really tough match with some of the physicality that they have, and the way they isolate you, and you have to handle. Again, another 17-year-old doing something incredible, so yeah, really proud of him."
It was our third away match in a row, with a fourth to come at the weekend when we take on Brighton at the AMEX Stadium.
While it's been a lot of time on the road, Mikel knows his players are putting it all on the line to get results.
"The last week has been tough in Napoli, in Sunderland then coming here again. But again look at the attitude of the players, the desire they showed, and that’s what we have to do - go again."
It also means travel for our supporters, something Mikel is delighted to see.

"Unbelievable again, thank you so much everybody for travelling, creating an incredible atmosphere, supporting and making the players feel that this is an important competition that we want to go through and try to win it."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赞赏道曼表现难以置信
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈球队取胜及年轻球员的表现。
bodyZh: 在英格兰联赛杯4-2战胜伊普斯维奇的比赛中，米克尔·阿尔特塔形容马克斯·道曼的表现不可思议，这位少年独中两元。
比赛开始不到10分钟他就取得进球，成为该赛事历史上第二年轻的进球者，随后在下半场开场不到90分钟（注：原文如此）再次破门。
在谈到马克斯的表现时，他说：“他的表现再次令人难以置信；他在球场上展现的一些动作和串联让人赏心悦目。”
“他非常高效；他在比赛中的参与度越来越高；他能够保持更长时间的稳定输出，我们深知我们拥有这样的天才。”
首发的并非只有马克斯一人，马利·萨尔蒙在这场波特曼路球场的六球大战中沉着踢满了90分钟。
在谈到萨尔蒙的表现时，他说：“同样非常出色，考虑到对手的身体对抗以及他们孤立你的方式，这是一场非常艰难的比赛，你必须去应对。又是一位17岁的小伙子做出了不可思议的事情，所以是的，我为他感到非常自豪。”
这是我们连续第三个客场比赛，周末我们还将前往美国运通球场对阵布莱顿，迎来第四个客场。
尽管在路上花费了大量时间，但米克尔知道他的球员们为了取得好成绩付出了全部努力。
“过去的一周很艰难，去了那不勒斯、桑德兰，然后又来到这里。但再次看看球员们的态度、他们展现出的渴望，这就是我们必须做的——重新出发。”
这也意味着我们的球迷需要随队出征，米克尔对这一点感到非常高兴。
“再次感谢大家，非常感谢所有人长途跋涉来到这里，营造了不可思议的氛围，支持并让球员们感受到这是一项我们想要晋级并争取赢得冠军的重要赛事。”

items.titleEn: Ipswich Town 2-4 Arsenal: Carabao Cup third round – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Max Dowman struck twice as the Gunners eased past the hosts to advance to the fourth roundAllan Castle writes in:As a British-born Canadian, who has shuttled back and forth over the Atlantic for six decades, when I get back to England I seek out cherished beverages past and present that are unavailable or only sporadically found in Canada: orange squash, ginger beer, Theakston’s Old Peculier, real bitter, etc. What is Carabao? What does it taste like? And, perhaps most important, what are the cultural assumptions British people make about Carabao drinkers? I’m old enough to know that no seemingly benign refreshment decision in the UK is made without social consequences.With Enciso on the bench, Arsenal will win. It’s too bad for Ipswich’s lack of courage. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Ed Aarons reports from Portman Road, with plenty of praise for Arsenal’s youngsters. That’s all from me. Thanks for reading!
A very happy night for Arsenal fans.
It goes down as Max Dowman’s night. Noni Madueke was dangerous, too, skipping down the right, and Ipswich never really threatened to do something special.
Arteta’s men progress. A tidy night, even with those two Ipswich goals in the second half.
Davis sends in a low cross from the left, Akpom collects, turns and shoots, and adds some respectability to the scoreline.
A goal against his former club!
90 min: Just two extra minutes added on.
88 min: Alan Baverstock writes in.
double quotation markDowman is definitely in the England team for the next World Cup isn’t he? Who else from the next generation?
He’ll be 20 – ancient – at the next World Cup.
87 min: Salmon intercepts by the halfway line and is taken down by Núñez, who goes in the book.
85 min: Ife Ibrahim is on for Arsenal, replacing Zubimendi. Ødegaard sends in a corner, punched by Walton.
84 min: Arsenal give the possession stats a boost.
81 min: There’s a handball shout inside the Arsenal area … but the ref blows for offside.
80 min: The game turns end-to-end, with Walton saving from Tzolis before Clarke very nearly has a chance to shoot for Ipswich.
77 min: Ipswich only started to play in the first half after going 2-0 down. It’s been a similar story this half, two more conceded before rediscovering some intensity.
76 min: Eze and the impressive Madueke go off. Ødegaard and Tzolis come on.
74 min: Gyökeres’ difficult game continues, unable to take control of the ball as Arsenal break … Ipswich respond with a shot on target, Arrizabalaga getting low to his right to hold on.
73 min: Eze twists and turns on the left and tries a cross/shot that travels wide.
72 min: Julienne overcooks a ball directed towards Lewis-Skelly, who drifts inside the area.
70 min: Leif Davis is on for Ipswich … and he whips in a delicious cross from the left. Arrizabalaga does well to collect cleanly.
68 min: Akpom, who started his career at Arsenal, finds the sidenetting with a cross.
65 min: Theo Julienne, 18 years old, is on for Guimarães.

Clarke, replacing Philogene on the left for Ipswich, drives down the wing and cuts back for Mehmeti, who finds the bottom corner to give Ipswich fans something to shout about. Or to set up the greatest comeback in Carabao history.
Instant impact from Clarke!
61 min: Ipswich make changes, with Chuba Akpom and Jack Clarke sent on.
Merino collects on the edge of the area and has enough space to curl in with his left foot. Clinical.
And another.
57 min: Arsenal continue to dominate the ball.

54 min: The corner is worked short … and the ball eventually finds Madueke inside the area, an excellent first touch setting him up for an effort … he pokes it across goal instead, perhaps hoping to find Gyökeres, but it escapes the centre-forward.
53 min: Madueke takes on Ouattara, who times his challenge well, leading to an Arsenal corner.
52 min: Arsenal knock it around at the back.
50 min: Flemming fights for the ball out on Ipswich’s left, gets a decent cross in … but he needs to be in the middle, too. Arrizabalaga collects.

Madueke pokes the ball through to Zubimendi inside the area, and he finds Dowman on the right-hand side. He calmly slots in once again – there’s a shout for an Ipswich handball in there, but the 16-year-old’s finish makes it irrelevant.
That’ll wrap it up.
46 min: We go again, with Arsenal on the ball and Lewis-Skelly drifting from left-back into midfield.
A change from Arsenal: Ezri Konsa replaces Gabriel.
Arsenal have had moments where they’ve been a bit open, particularly down the Ipswich left, where Zubimendi is filling in. But Gabriel has been typically solid, nipping in to sort any issues.
Kári Tulinius writes in:
double quotation markThe way Max Dowman cut through the Ipswich defense it was as if he was a 26-year-old playing against 16-year-olds.
A fairly smooth half for the Premier League champions.
45 min: We’ll have an extra minute.
43 min: Ipswich have been much better since going two-down but … well, they’re two-down.
41 min: Guimarães very nearly sneaks a ball to Eze inside the area, but it’s cut out by a blue shirt.
40 min: Mehmeti finds the ball on the left for Ipswich as they break, just Gabriel ahead of him … but it’s Gabriel. He doesn’t dive in, keeping Mehmeti quiet while Arsenal retreat.
37 min: Philogene, on Ipswich’s left, goes around the outside, into the area, leaving Salmon on the floor … but Arrizabalaga gets in the way of his cutback.
36 min: Gyökeres has had a quiet half.
35 min: Eze cuts in from the left … and has his shot blocked.
34 min: Merino gives away the ball in midfield and Ipswich win a corner … Núñez sends it into the front post, it’s flicked into a dangerous area … but Gabriel, once again, is there to save Arsenal.
32 min: Salmon slips up for Arsenal and Ipswich break forward … but Gabriel, the senior man at the back, slides in to clean up inside his area.

items.titleZh: 伊普斯维奇 2-4 阿森纳：联赛杯第三轮比赛实录
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·道曼梅开二度，阿森纳轻取对手晋级第四轮。
bodyZh: 埃德·阿隆斯从波特曼路球场发回报道，并对阿森纳的年轻球员们赞不绝口。我的播报就到这里，感谢阅读！
对于阿森纳球迷来说这是一个非常快乐的夜晚。
这个夜晚属于马克斯·道曼。马杜埃凯在右路的突破也极具威胁，伊普斯维奇从未真正构成实质威胁。
阿尔特塔的球队晋级了。这是一场轻松的比赛，尽管下半场丢了两个球。
戴维斯从左路送出低平球传中，阿克蓬接球转身射门，为球队挽回了一些颜面。
攻破老东家球门！
第90分钟：仅补时两分钟。
第88分钟：阿兰·巴弗斯特罗姆来信称。
道曼肯定能入选下一届世界杯的英格兰队吧？还有哪位是下一代新星？
到下一届世界杯时他才20岁——还很年轻。
第87分钟：萨尔蒙在半场附近拦截，被努涅斯犯规放倒，后者吃到黄牌。
第85分钟：伊费·易卜拉欣替补登场为阿森纳出场，换下祖比门迪。厄德高罚出角球，沃尔顿将球击出。
第84分钟：阿森纳进一步提升了控球率数据。
第81分钟：阿森纳禁区内疑似有手球……但裁判吹越位在先。
第80分钟：比赛进入对攻战，沃尔顿扑出了齐奥利斯的射门，随后克拉克险些为伊普斯维奇获得射门机会。
第77分钟：伊普斯维奇在上半场落后两球后才开始进入状态。下半场也是如此，在找回强度之前又丢了两球。
第76分钟：埃泽和表现出色的马杜埃凯离场。厄德高和齐奥利斯替补登场。
第74分钟：哲凯赖什表现艰难，在阿森纳反击时无法控制住球……伊普斯维奇随后回敬一脚射门，阿里萨巴拉加倒地将球按在身下。
第73分钟：埃泽在左路连续盘带后尝试传中兼射门，皮球偏出。
第72分钟：于连传球过大，未能给到插向禁区内的刘易斯-斯凯利。
第70分钟：利夫·戴维斯替补登场为伊普斯维奇出战……他从左路送出一脚精妙传中。阿里萨巴拉加稳稳将球摘下。
第68分钟：职业生涯出道于阿森纳的阿克蓬传中击中边网。
第65分钟：18岁的特奥·于连替补登场换下吉马良斯。
替补登场的克拉克在伊普斯维奇左路突破吉马良斯后横传，梅梅蒂推射远角得手，为主场球迷带来了欢呼的理由，也为他们保留了创造联赛杯历史最大翻盘的希望。
克拉克替补登场即建功！
第61分钟：伊普斯维奇进行换人调整，丘巴·阿克蓬和杰克·克拉克替补登场。
梅里诺在禁区边缘得球，获得足够的空间后用左脚兜射破门。极其冷酷。
再进一球。
第57分钟：阿森纳继续掌控球权。
第54分钟：角球短传配合……皮球最终传到禁区内的马杜埃凯脚下，他极佳的第一触球调整好步点……但他没有选择射门，而是将球横扫门前，或许是希望找到哲凯赖什，但球滑门而过。
第53分钟：马杜埃凯对位瓦塔拉，后者防守时机掌握得很好，为阿森纳赢得一个角球。
第52分钟：阿森纳在后场倒脚。
第50分钟：弗莱明在伊普斯维奇左路拼抢得球，送出一脚不错的传中……但他自己也需要赶到中路接应。阿里萨巴拉加将球没收。
马杜埃凯将球捅给禁区内的祖比门迪，后者顺势分给右路的道曼。他从容冷静地再次推射破门——虽然伊普斯维奇球员投诉有手球嫌疑，但这名16岁小将的射门让这一切变得不再重要。
这球锁定了胜局。
第46分钟：下半场比赛开始，阿森纳控球，刘易斯-斯凯利从左后卫位置游弋到中场。
阿森纳做出换人调整：埃兹里·孔萨替换加布里埃尔。
阿森纳有过防守空虚的时刻，特别是在伊普斯维奇的左路，祖比门迪在那里补防。但加布里埃尔一如既往地稳健，及时上抢化解了险情。
卡里·图利尼乌斯来信称：
马森·道曼切入伊普斯维奇防线的方式，就像是一个26岁的成年人在踢16岁小孩。
对于英超冠军来说，这是一个相当顺利的上半场。
第45分钟：上半场将补时一分钟。
第43分钟：伊普斯维奇在两球落后之后表现好了很多，但……毕竟他们已经落后两球了。
第41分钟：吉马良斯险些将球塞给禁区内的埃泽，但被身穿蓝衣的防守球员截断。
第40分钟：梅梅蒂在伊普斯维奇反击中在左路得球，前方只有加布里埃尔……但他可是加布里埃尔。他没有贸然上抢，而是压制住梅梅蒂的突破，同时等待阿森纳全队回防。
第37分钟：伊普斯维奇左路的菲洛根内带球内切杀入禁区，晃倒了萨尔蒙……但阿里萨巴拉加封堵了对方的倒三角回传。
第36分钟：哲凯赖什在上半场存在感不强。
第35分钟：埃泽从左路内切……但射门被封堵。
第34分钟：梅里诺在中场丢球，伊普斯维奇赢得角球……努涅斯将球传向近门柱，皮球被蹭到危险区域……但加布里埃尔再次挺身而出拯救了阿森纳。
第32分钟：萨尔蒙防守失误导致阿森纳防线被反击突破……但后防老将加布里埃尔滑铲将禁区内的险情化解。

bodyEn: The bad news for everyone else is that Arsenal’s next generation is already here. Two mesmerising goals and an assist in a man-of-the-match display from Max Dowman underlined why the 16-year-old has been compared to a certain Lionel Messi by his manager, Mikel Arteta, as Ipswich were swatted aside with ease. Almost as impressive was the performance of the 17-year-old Marli Salmon, who oozed class in central defence on only the second senior start of his career.

Ipswich won here the last time these two sides met in this competition, in 2011, but were beaten 3-0 in the second leg of the semi-final at the Emirates before Arsenal infam­ously lost to Birmingham in the final. ­Fifteen years on, Gary O’Neil’s heavily rotated side stood no chance against last year’s runners up after Dowman’s brilliant opening goal. Noni Madueke and the stand-in skipper Mikel Merino were also on target as Arsenal made it seven wins out of seven to start the new campaign. Having finally ended their long wait for silverware in style, this team are hungry for more and know they can now rely on one of the most exciting talents ever to have emerged from their Hale End academy.

“He can deliver those actions effortlessly. That’s his biggest quality,” said Arteta of the delightful shimmy that preceded Dowman’s first goal. “It’s a joy to have him. But what we have to do is look after him. He’s 16 years old, you don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context. We really need to make sure every time we throw him in, he’s in the right context with the right ­preparation. That’s what we are ­trying to do.”

Both managers made their prior­ities clear as there were a combined 19 changes from their sides’ wins in the Premier League at the weekend. After a summer of heavy spending, many of those who helped Ipswich bounce straight back from the Championship last season were given an opportunity to stake a claim but largely failed to do so. “It’s the most extreme test that you can face,” admitted O’Neil. “Every time we made a mistake we were punished.”

Dowman’s most recent first-team appearance was in the final game of last season when Arsenal were crowned champions, and he has since completed his GCSEs before spending a week in New York during the World Cup where he rubbed shoulders with Paul Pogba.

Arteta said beforehand he would have “earn his minutes” like anyone else and it only took seven of them for Dowman to seize his opportunity. Ipswich’s fans were taunting their Arsenal counterparts about never being crowned European champions when he muscled Santiago Núñez off the ball on the halfway line and set off towards the penalty area. The imposing figure of Cédric Kipré – all 6ft 3in of him – was all that stood in Dowman’s way but he went past the Ivory Coast defender in a flurry of feet before cooly dispatching a shot into the corner and performing a Thierry Henry knee slide for good measure.

Peterborough moved into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup for the first time since 2009 thanks to a 7-6 penalty shootout victory over Barnsley that followed a thrilling 3-3 draw between the two League One sides.

Barnsley were handed the lead after 61 seconds when a clearance by the Peterborough goalkeeper, Alex Bass, was charged down by Cameron McGeehan, with the Tykes captain nodding in after the ball had come off the bar.
Peterborough equalised in the 19th minute when Lucca Mendonca’s cross was pushed out by the Barnsley goalkeeper, Kieran Flavell, as far as Harry Leonard, who prodded in.

The hosts then completed the turnaround after 27 minutes when Harley Mills’ free-kick was headed in by the unmarked Danny Ormerod. But the Tykes were level five minutes before half-time when Reyes Cleary beat Mendonca with ease down the left before placing his shot into the bottom corner.
The visitors looked to have won it when Cleary bent in his second in the 74th minute, but Ormerod sent the tie to penalties with by heading in Mills’ cross with just two minutes remaining.
After 12 successful spot-kicks, a tame effort from Barnsley’s Luke Alker was saved by Bass, giving Harrison Jones the chance to send the hosts through, which he dispatched.

Brentford emerged from a tense finish against Reading to book their place in the Carabao Cup fourth round with a 2-1 victory. Callum Wilson and Fabio Carvalho were on target in the first half as the Premier League club showed a clinical touch against League One opposition, who produced a number of chances but lacked the firepower to finish them off. Paudie O’Connor eventually pulled one back to revive Reading’s challenge and Brentford could not rest easy in the remaining 18 minutes, although the substitute Igor Thiago was among those who should have killed the match off. Press Association

Ipswich’s mission got even harder when Madueke hammered in after Bruno Guimarães and Merino had combined to set him up after Dowman had started the press. Barely a quarter of an hour had been played. To their credit, the hosts rallied and it needed a clearance off the line from Salmon to deny Zian Flemming. Not to be outdone by Dowman, Salmon – who signed his professional contact when he turned 17 last month having also played in the Champions League and FA Cup last season – set out on a slaloming run just before half-time after calmly turning his way out of trouble under pressure from Flemming, drawing a round of applause from the Arsenal bench.

Ipswich’s hopes of mounting a comeback were extinguished within two minutes of the restart when Dowman struck again. Martín Zubimendi’s pass found him on the edge of the six-yard box and the finish was caressed into the far corner. Merino then curled home off the post from Dowman’s touch to put the result beyond any doubt, although the biggest roar of the evening came when Ipswich hit back through Anis Mehmeti after he was set up by the substitute Jack Clarke.

Including Myles Lewis-Skelly – a relative veteran these days at 19 and surely in line for an England recall this week after an excellent start to the season – Arsenal had four teenagers on the pitch at the end after the 18-year-old Theo Julienne came on at right-back. Even Ipswich had a Hale End grad­uate in their ranks by then as Chuba Akpom grabbed another consolation in injury time via a deflection. But, not for the last time one suspects, it was Dowman’s name that was on everyone’s lips at the end.

items.titleZh: 麦克斯·道曼独中两元助阿森纳替补阵容在联赛杯中击败伊普斯维奇
items.summaryZh: 16岁的道曼在联赛杯中奉献两球一助攻，帮助阿森纳轻松击败伊普斯维奇晋级。
bodyZh: 对其他人来说，坏消息是阿森纳的新生代已经到来。16岁的麦克斯·道曼在比赛中上演了全场最佳表现，奉献了两粒精彩的进球和一次助攻，这也印证了为什么主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔将这位年轻人与某位莱昂内尔·梅西相提并论，伊普斯维奇最终被轻松轻取。同样令人印象深刻的是17岁球员马利·萨尔蒙的表现，他在职业生涯仅有的第二次一线队首发出场中，在中央防守位置上展现出了极高的水准。

这两支球队上一次在该项赛事中相遇是在2011年，当时伊普斯维奇在这里取胜，但在酋长球场的半决赛次回合中以0比3失利，随后阿森纳在决赛中遗憾不敌伯明翰。十五年后，加里·奥尼尔大幅轮换的阵容在面对去年的亚军时毫无胜算，道曼打入了精彩的远射首开纪录。诺尼·马杜埃凯和代理队长米克尔·梅里诺也分别建功，阿森纳在新赛季开局取得了七连胜。在终于如愿以偿结束了长时间的冠军荒后，这支球队对更多荣誉充满渴望，并且深知他们现在可以依仗青训营中涌现出的最令人兴奋的天才之一。
“他能够毫不费力地完成这些动作。这是他最大的特点，”阿尔特塔谈到道曼第一球前那次精彩的晃动时说道。“拥有他是种快乐。但我们要做的就是保护他。他只有16岁，你在英超联赛中看不到这样的情况。在欧洲其他联赛，那是完全不同的环境。我们真的需要确保每次派他上场时，他都处于正确的环境并做好了充分的准备。这正是我们努力在做的。”
双方主教练都明确了各自的优先级，因为两队在周末英超联赛取胜的基础上总共作出了19处人员调整。经过一个夏天的巨额引援，许多帮助伊普斯维奇在上赛季直接从英冠升级的球员得到了证明自己的机会，但大多未能把握住。“这是你可能面临的最极端考验，”奥尼尔承认道。“我们每一次犯错都受到了惩罚。”
道曼上一次代表一线队出场是在上赛季阿森纳加冕冠军的最后一轮比赛中，自那以后他完成了普通中等教育证书考试（GCSEs），随后在世界杯期间前往纽约度过了一周，在那里与保罗·博格巴有过接触。
阿尔特塔赛前表示，他需要像其他人一样“挣得出场时间”，而道曼只用了七分钟就抓住了机会。当他在中场线从圣地亚哥·努涅斯脚下抢断并向禁区挺进时，伊普斯维奇球迷还在嘲笑阿森纳从未加冕欧洲冠军。身材高大的塞德里克·基普雷身高6英尺3英寸，是他面前唯一的障碍，但道曼在一阵眼花缭乱的脚法中晃过了这位科特迪瓦后卫，随后冷静地将球送入死角，并顺势模仿蒂埃里·亨利来了一次滑跪庆祝。
皮特堡联队凭借在点球大战中7比6战胜巴恩斯利，自2009年以来首次闯入联赛杯第四轮，此前两支英甲球队在常规时间战成3比3平。
巴恩斯利在比赛开始61秒后取得领先，当时皮特堡联队门将亚历克斯·巴斯的解围被卡梅伦·麦吉汉挡出，皮球击中横梁后由泰克斯队队长头球补射破门。
皮特堡联队在第19分钟扳平比分，卢卡·门多萨的传中被巴恩斯利门将基兰·弗拉维尔扑出，哈里·莱昂纳德补射得手。
主队随后在第27分钟完成反超，哈利·米尔斯的任意球被无人盯防的丹尼·奥尔默罗头球顶进。但客队在半场结束前五分钟将比分扳平，雷耶斯·克利里在左路轻松过掉门多萨后将球射入底角。
当克利里在第74分钟兜射攻入个人第二球时，客队看似已经锁定胜局，但奥尔默罗在比赛还剩两分钟时接米尔斯传中头球破门，将比赛拖入点球大战。
在12次成功的点球之后，巴恩斯利球员卢克·阿尔克的绵软射门被巴斯扑出，给了哈里森·琼斯为主队罚进制胜点球的机会，他稳稳罚中。
布伦特福德在与雷丁的紧张对决中以2比1取胜，锁定了联赛杯第四轮的席位。卡勒姆·威尔逊和法比奥·卡瓦略在上半场建功，展现了这支英超球队面对英甲对手时的门前效率，客队虽然创造了不少机会但缺乏终结能力。保迪·奥康纳随后为雷丁扳回一城重燃希望，布伦特福德在剩下的18分钟里不敢松懈，尽管替补出场的伊戈尔·蒂亚戈本有机会杀死比赛悬念。美联社
伊普斯维奇的任务变得更加艰巨，在道曼发动前场逼抢后，布鲁诺·吉马良斯和梅里诺联手助攻马杜埃凯轰门得手。当时比赛才进行了刚刚过一刻钟。值得赞赏的是，主队随后发起反扑，萨尔蒙门线解围挡出了齐安·弗莱明的射门。萨尔蒙上个月年满17岁时签署了职业合同，上赛季还在欧冠和足总杯中有过登场，他不甘示弱，在半场结束前面对弗莱明的紧逼冷静摆脱困境后开始了一次长途奔袭，赢得了阿森纳替补席的一片掌声。

伊普斯维奇逆转的希望在下半场开始两分钟后彻底破灭，当时道曼再次破门。马丁·祖比门迪的传球找到了小禁区边缘的他，他将球轻巧地推入远角。随后梅里诺接道曼的传球在门柱边兜射破门，彻底锁定了胜局，不过全场最大的欢呼声来自于伊普斯维奇由替补出场的杰克·克拉克助攻阿尼斯·穆罕默迪扳回一城时。
算上迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利——如今19岁的他已算是一名“老将”，且凭借出色的赛季开局本周有望重新入选英格兰代表团——阿森纳在比赛结束时场上有四名青少年球员，此前18岁的特奥·于利安替补登场司职右后卫。甚至连伊普斯维奇阵中当时也有了一位黑尔恩德青训毕业生，丘巴·阿克庞在补时阶段通过折射打入了一粒安慰奖性质的进球。不过，人们在终场时议论纷纷的名字依然是道曼，这恐怕不会是最后一次。

items.summaryEn: Enjoy some of our best long range efforts from years gone by
bodyEn: Bruno Guimaraes opened his Gunners account in style with a rocket to put us ahead against Sunderland, continuing a recent trend of Gunners finding the net from distance.

Our Brazilian fired a powerful strike in off the underside of the crossbar to break the deadlock at the Stadium of Light, adding to Kai Havertz's strike from outside the penalty area against Chelsea as the pick of our goals so far this season.
In total, we have scored 14 times from outside the box in Premier League matches since the start of last season, and only Aston Villa boast more in that timeframe.

There were plenty of stunners to celebrate last season on our road to the Premier League title, from Eberechi Eze's outstanding winner against Newcastle United to Viktor Gyokeres' devastating derby goal at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

bodyZh: 吉马良斯以一记精彩的火箭炮般远射打入了他在阿森纳的处子球，帮助我们领先桑德兰，延续了近期阿森纳球员远射破门的趋势。

Manchester City beat Manchester United at Old Trafford with a controversial Erling Haaland goal. Has the job of referees become too difficult for regular folk, and do we need Nasa scientists or data wonks instead at Pro Ref?

Elsewhere, Arsenal beat Sunderland in spite of a debatable decision of their own, there are more goals at both ends at Stamford Bridge, absolutely no goals in sight for Spurs, and another goal of the season contender from an unlikely source.
Plus, there’s trouble at Aston Villa, another draw for Bournemouth and a discussion about the lost art of grappling.

bodyEn: Arsenal are seeking an explanation from Pro Ref over the penalty awarded to Sunderland on Saturday, which Mikel Arteta described as “unacceptable at this level”. It is understood the Premier League champions contacted Pro Ref on Monday to request a meeting after Ezri Konsa was penalised during an incident involving Dan Ballard at the Stadium of Light.
David Raya made a brilliant save to deny Enzo Le Fée’s spot-kick before Arsenal went on to win 2-0.

Arteta could not hide his anger afterwards, and other Arsenal officials are said to have been left annoyed by the penalty decision. Arsenal are expected to question why the video assistant referee did not intervene when the referee, John Brooks, pointed to the spot.

They are also likely to bring up the fact that the Premier League’s key match incidents (KMI) panel unanimously ruled the club should have been awarded a penalty in their win at Aston Villa last month when Bruno Guimarães was fouled by Ian Maatsen.

The KMI panel ruled last season that Gabriel Magalhães should have been shown a red card for violent conduct against Manchester City in April that would have ruled the Brazil defender out for three matches in the title run-in.

Arteta said the decision against Sunderland “could have cost us the win and our momentum” after a 100% start and Arsenal’s fear is that refereeing mistakes and inconsistencies could end up deciding the title race.

They, like other Premier League clubs, are in regular dialogue with Pro Ref and are expected to ask for clarification on whether similar incidents to the one involving Konsa and Ballard from a corner will result in more penalties being given.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳要求职业裁判公司就对阵桑德兰的点球判罚给出解释。
bodyZh: 阿森纳正就周六对阵桑德兰时被判罚的点球向职业裁判公司寻求解释，米克尔·阿尔特塔将该判罚形容为“在这一水平上不可接受”。据了解，这家英超俱乐部已于周一联系职业裁判公司要求会面，此前埃兹里·孔萨在光明球场与丹·巴拉德的冲突中被判犯规。
大卫·拉亚做出了一次精彩扑救，挡出了恩佐·勒费埃主罚的点球，随后阿森纳以2比0取胜。
阿尔特塔赛后无法掩饰他的愤怒，据说其他阿森纳官员也对这次点球判罚感到不满。预计阿森纳将质疑为什么当主裁判约翰·布鲁克斯指向点球点时，视频助理裁判没有介入。
他们还可能会提及这样一个事实：英超关键比赛判罚小组上个月一致裁定，在上个月客场击败阿斯顿维拉的比赛中，当布鲁诺·吉马良斯对伊恩·马特森犯规时，俱乐部本应获得一个点球。
关键比赛判罚小组上赛季曾裁定，加布里埃尔·马加良斯在4月对阵曼城的比赛中因暴力行为本应吃到红牌，这将导致这名巴西后卫在争冠冲刺阶段缺席三场比赛。
阿尔特塔表示，针对桑德兰的这一判罚“本可能让我们失去胜利和势头”，此前球队取得了百分之百的开局，阿森纳担心裁判的失误和判罚不一致最终可能会决定争冠走势。
他们与其他英超俱乐部一样，与职业裁判公司保持着定期对话，预计将要求澄清：涉及孔萨和巴拉德在角球防守中的类似事件是否会导致更多的点球判罚。

bodyEn: The 199th Manchester derby was defined by two refereeing decisions: Phil Foden’s first-half red card for kicking out at Bruno Fernandes, and the intervention by the video assistant referee to award Erling Haaland’s winning goal despite Enzo Fernández appearing to interfere with play from an offside position. In both cases, a healthy dose of common sense might have led to a different outcome and Pro Ref admitted that Haaland’s goal should not have stood. Still, it is tough to argue that the final result was harsh on United. Foden’s dismissal gave the hosts a huge opportunity they failed to take, their best chance falling to Bryan Mbeumo in stoppage time. Michael Carrick began his reign with a 2-0 home derby win against 11 men in January, so this felt like a backward step for the manager, unable to find a way to control the game. Carrick also bemoaned City’s two days of extra rest after Champions League games, but chose to keep Fernandes and others on for 90 minutes in the 4-0 stroll past Sabah. United’s next two league games are away at Fulham and at home to Spurs. Carrick will need to be smarter to stop an early-season wobble becoming something more serious. Niall McVeigh

Foden’s red card also posed a big test for Enzo Maresca, overseeing his first derby as Manchester City manager. After a solid but unspectacular start to the league season, this could have become a painful afternoon with his team down to 10 men. Instead, the Italian made smart decisions to secure a galvanising result and keep pace with Arsenal, both teams already edging clear of their expected rivals. Maresca made just one change in the first 80 minutes, but bringing on Iliman Ndiaye for Rayan Cherki gave his team a more direct threat on the break. Fellow new signings Enzo Fernández and Elliot Anderson have settled quickly, the latter imperious in midfield during a second half where City rarely looked short-handed. At the back, Marc Guéhi barely put a foot wrong as City showed a solidity that had been lacking. The manner of Haaland’s winner was fortunate, to say the least, but the visitors’ second-half display deserved all three points. NMc
Match report: Manchester United 0-1 Manchester City

On another day, any of the excellent individual goals from Charalampos Kostoulas, Malick Yalcouyé and Yasin Ayari could have been the showstopper in Brighton’s rout of Coventry. But none could compare with Lewis Dunk’s sensational 35-yard pile-driver into the top corner. For a centre-back to even consider shooting from where he did is ridiculous, but Dunk insisted he has “that sort of shot in my locker”, with Fabian Hürzeler saying everyone at the club knows all about the shooting technique he possesses. Dunk was one of five goalscorers on Sunday as Brighton continue to show they can do things differently to last season, when Danny Welbeck was their chief attacking threat with 13 Premier League goals. Eight players have scored in four league games and who really needs a star striker when your centre-back can hit a ball like that? Ben Bloom
Match report: Coventry 0-5 Brighton

Referees are supposed to be clamping down on grappling, holding and shirt-pulling at dead balls this season, but until the 58th minute at the Stadium of Light on Saturday Sunderland and Arsenal got away with plenty at corners and throws. The irony was that when John Brooks penalised Ezri Konsa for hauling Dan Ballard down at a throw and awarded Sunderland a penalty, subsequently endorsed by a VAR check, it proved contentious. There was a strong case for arguing that Ballard’s clever “judo roll” had landed the admittedly far from innocent Konsa in deep trouble. No matter that David Raya’s brilliant save ensured Enzo Le Fée’s penalty proved academic; Mikel Arteta subsequently cut a study in righteous indignation. Going over the top, he said he felt “sad” for football and talked about wanting to “protect the game”. When, two minutes after Le Fée’s miss, Bruno Guimarães curled in a superlative shot Arsenal were en route to a 2-0 win sealed by Bukayo Saka’s late penalty and their immaculate start to the season continued. Sunderland, though, had played well and deserved more credit from a less than magnanimous Arteta. Louise Taylor
Match report: Sunderland 0-2 Arsenal

Andoni Iraola will inevitably discover some unwelcome truths in the learning stage of his Liverpool reign. A second successive Premier League draw at Anfield – their seventh from 12 games in 2026 – revealed several, from Kostas Tsimikas’s unreliability as a starter to the porous nature of a central midfield pairing of Ryan Gravenberch and Dominik Szoboszlai. Iraola had to make changes given the tight turnaround from Wednesday’s Champions League win over Atlético Madrid, his first experience of having to do so with Liverpool, and the absence of Alexis Mac Allister had more of a destabilising effect than he might have imagined. Gravenberch and Szoboszlai offered minimal resistance to a Fulham team that cut through with ease and, together with Florian Wirtz, offered little to an ineffective Liverpool attack assembled at huge expense. There will be further changes when Tottenham visit in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday. Teenage midfielder Trey Nyoni, impressive in pre-season, should get an opportunity to show he can be a viable alternative the next time Mac Allister is rested. Andy Hunter
Match report: Liverpool 0-0 Fulham

Roberto De Zerbi insisted there “is not a problem” between him and Mathys Tel, when nobody had seriously suggested there was. “I love Mathys as a player, as a guy,” the Tottenham manager said. Still, it was not a good day for Tel against Everton. Dropped from the starting XI, he received an on-pitch tutorial from De Zerbi in how to play as a No 9. The Tottenham manager had moved Tel there in the closing stages after initially introducing him in his favoured left-wing role. Play on the shoulder, attack the six-yard box, was the gist of De Zerbi’s advice. Spurs’ toothlessness at the sharp end of their formation was not on Tel. The real worry was Dominic Solanke and how he ghosted through another Premier League game. Omar Marmoush was also ineffective; first on the left, then briefly as the No 9 after Solanke was withdrawn. Solanke has been undermined by injuries, but 12 league goals since his £55m arrival in August 2024 is not good enough. David Hytner

Match report: Tottenham 0-0 Everton

Crystal Palace’s defenders committed the cardinal sin of not playing to the whistle when they allowed Ipswich to equalise during the first half of Saturday’s costly 3-2 defeat. It was just the latest example of the bad habits that are creeping in since Pierre Sage’s arrival as manager. While the Frenchman promised to speak to Axel Disasi after his reckless red card in the first half cost Palace dear, it was surprising to hear Sage say: “I had this discussion with them because they did the same thing in a session. I told them to continue to play. Because of the VAR now, I prefer they deflect the ball [out] for a corner and then ask the referee if they were offside or not.” Palace are lacking leadership at the back after selling Maxence Lacroix to Chelsea and have conceded seven goals in their first two matches at home. Sage must find a solution to their defensive woes without Disasi, who will miss their next three Premier League matches due to suspension. Ed Aarons
Match report: Crystal Palace 2-3 Ipswich

Chelsea do not relish the art of defending enough. Hull’s first goal on Saturday was a case in point. Malo Gusto was outmuscled by Ryan Giles and Mohamed Belloumi equalised when Jorrel Hato misjudged the Hull left-back’s cross. Xabi Alonso called it soft. The Chelsea manager replaced Hato at half-time, but the problems are not down to one individual. Emiliano Martínez, signed as Robert Sanchez’s replacement, is yet to convince in goal. Wesley Fofana still flatters to deceive, Levi Colwill is feeling his way back from injury and Maxence Lacroix was surprisingly on the bench against Hull. Chelsea have conceded 12 goals in Alonso’s first six games in all competitions. They remain unserious. Jacob Steinberg
Match report: Chelsea 2-2 Hull

Oliver Glasner consistently name-checked James McAtee before a ball was kicked this season, adamant the £30m arrival from Manchester City last summer could finally make a splash in a Nottingham Forest shirt. His performance in their first victory of the season, at Aston Villa on Saturday, was further evidence of a player revitalised. Glasner is convinced the 23-year-old can thrive in the quarterback role he gave Adam Wharton at Crystal Palace. McAtee has started all four league matches this season, twice as many as he managed in the last campaign; he was hooked at half-time in successive starts against Utrecht and Wrexham either side of the turn of the year. But against Villa, McAtee oozed confidence and relished dictating the game. Glasner represents McAtee’s fifth Forest manager in 13 months, but in the Austrian he has one of his biggest fans. Ben Fisher
Match report: Aston Villa 1-2 Nottingham Forest

“Many teams struggle against Bournemouth,” said Brentford’s Vitaly Janelt. That has been true of all four opponents faced in Marco Rose’s Premier League tenure. And yet the wait for a first win continues. “If you watch our games, I think it’s a joy,” said Rose. This week, his squad jets off to face Real Sociedad in the Europa League, fulfilling the dream of fans and the club’s owner. Bill Foley. Rose, one of the game’s optimists, refused to cast blame on Djordje Petrovic’s goalkeeping errors for Kevin Schade’s double, instead looking ahead to Thursday: “A special night for the club against top opposition. It’s a tough stadium. Top atmosphere, intense opponent, a good team with Spanish national team players.” Bournemouth may well find life easier in Europe. As Justin Kluivert said: “It’s lovely to play in this team. We are front-footed, we press, we don’t just let it be a slow game, we go for it.” John Brewin
Match report: Bournemouth 2-2 Brentford

items.titleZh: 英超周末焦点：曼市德比争议不断，阿森纳开局连胜
items.summaryZh: 英超周末战罢，曼市德比因判罚引发争议，阿森纳客场战胜桑德兰延续全胜开局。
bodyZh: 第199场曼市德比由两次判罚决定：上半场福登因踢倒布鲁诺·费尔南德斯被红牌罚下，以及尽管恩佐·费尔南德斯疑似越位干扰，但VAR仍判定哈兰德的制胜球有效。在这两种情况下，一点常识本可能带来不同的结果，职业裁判公司也承认哈兰德的进球本不该有效。不过，很难说最终结果对曼联过于苛刻。福登被罚下为主队提供了一个巨大机会，但他们未能把握，姆贝乌莫在补时阶段错失了他们最好的机会。迈克尔·卡里克在1月以主场2-0击败11人曼城开启执教生涯，所以这对这位未能找到控制比赛方法的主帅来说感觉像是一次退步。卡里克还抱怨曼城在欧冠比赛后多了两天休息时间，但在4-0轻取萨巴特的比赛中，他却选择让费尔南德斯等人踢满90分钟。曼联接下来两场联赛是客场对阵富勒姆以及主场迎战热刺。卡里克需要表现得更聪明，以阻止赛季初的动荡演变成更严重的问题。尼尔·麦克维维

福登的红牌也对作为曼城新帅迎来首场德比的恩佐·马雷斯卡构成了重大考验。在英超开局表现稳健但并不惊艳之后，少打一人的球队本可能让他的这个下午变得痛苦不堪。相反，这位意大利教练做出了明智的决定，取得了提振士气的成绩，并紧咬阿森纳，两支球队已经开始甩开各自的预期竞争对手。在前80分钟里，马雷斯卡只做了一次换人，但用伊利曼·恩迪亚耶换下拉扬·谢尔基为球队的反击提供了更直接的威胁。同为新援的恩佐·费尔南德斯和埃利奥特·安德森已经迅速融入，后者在下半场的表现堪称中场核心，当时曼城几乎看不出少一人。在后防线上，马克·格伊几乎没有犯错，曼城展现出了以往所缺乏的稳健。至少可以说，哈兰德制胜球的方式带有幸运成分，但客队下半场的表现配得上全取三分。NMc
比赛报告：曼联 0-1 曼城

在另一天，查拉兰波斯·科斯图拉斯、马利克·亚尔库尤和亚辛·阿亚里任何一个精彩的个人进球，都足以成为布莱顿大胜考文垂时的惊艳之作。但没有任何一个能与刘易斯·邓克在35码外轰入球门顶角的惊天远射相提并论。一个中后卫竟然会考虑在那个位置射门简直荒谬，但邓克坚称他“那样的射门就在我的武器库里”，法比安·赫茨勒也表示俱乐部里的每个人都非常清楚他拥有的这种射门技术。周日邓克是五名进球球员之一，布莱顿继续展现出他们与上赛季不同的踢法，当时丹尼·维尔贝克以14个英超进球是他们的主要进攻威胁。八名球员在四场联赛中取得了进球，当你的中后卫能踢出那种球时，谁还真正需要一个超级前锋呢？本·布鲁姆
比赛报告：考文垂 0-5 布莱顿

本赛季裁判本应加大对定位球战术中拉拽、抱摔和拉扯球衣行为的打击力度，但在周六光明球场的第58分钟之前，桑德兰和阿森纳在角球和界外球防守中逃过了许多犯规。讽刺的是，当约翰·布鲁克斯因埃兹里·孔萨在界外球时拉倒丹·巴拉德而判给桑德兰点球，并随后通过VAR复核确认时，这个判罚引发了争议。有强有力的理由认为，巴拉德聪明的“柔道式翻滚”让承认并非完全无辜的孔萨陷入了巨大麻烦。大卫·拉亚的出色扑救确保了恩佐·勒费埃的点球流于形式，这并不重要；米克尔·阿尔特塔随后表现出一副义愤填膺的样子。他情绪激动地表示，他为足球感到“难过”，并谈到了想要“保护比赛”。在勒费埃罚丢点球两分钟后，布鲁诺·吉马良斯兜射打入了一记无与伦比的进球，阿森纳朝着2-0的胜利稳步前进，最终由萨卡在尾声阶段罚入点球锁定胜局，他们完美的赛季开局得以延续。不过，桑德兰表现出色，理应得到阿尔特塔更多大度一些的赞赏。路易斯·泰勒
比赛报告：桑德兰 0-2 阿森纳

安多尼·伊劳拉在执教利物浦的学习阶段不可避免地发现了一些令人不快的真相。在安菲尔德遭遇连续第二场英超平局——这是他们2026年12场比赛中的第七场平局——暴露出了几个问题，从科斯塔斯·齐米卡斯作为首发球员的不稳定性，到瑞安·赫拉芬贝赫和多米尼克·索博斯莱组成的中场中路组合形同虚设。由于周三欧冠击败马德里竞技后赛程紧凑，这是伊劳拉执教利物浦以来首次不得不进行轮换，而亚历克西斯·麦卡利斯特的缺阵带来的破坏性影响超出了他的想象。赫拉芬贝赫和索博斯莱对轻而易举撕开防线的富勒姆几乎没有构成抵抗，再加上弗洛里安·维尔茨，他们对利物浦这套花费巨大组建却效率低下的锋线提供不了多少帮助。周二热刺造访卡拉宝杯时将会有进一步的轮换。在季前赛中表现出色的十多岁中场球员特雷·尼奥尼，应该得到机会证明自己在下次麦卡利斯特轮休时能够成为一个可行的替代方案。安迪·亨特
比赛报告：利物浦 0-0 富勒姆

罗伯托·德泽尔比坚称他和马蒂斯·特尔之间“没有问题”，尽管此前根本没人严肃地认为他们之间有问题。“我作为球员、作为一个小伙子，都很喜欢马蒂斯，”这位热刺主帅说道。尽管如此，对阵埃弗顿对特尔来说并不是美好的一天。他被排除在首发阵容之外，并在场上接受了德泽尔比关于如何踢9号位的现场教学。热刺主帅在最初安排特尔在他擅长的左边锋位置后，在比赛尾声阶段将他调到了中路。德泽尔比建议的核心要点是：在防线身侧游弋，冲击小禁区。热刺在阵型最前端的疲软并不能归咎于特尔。真正令人担忧的是多米尼克·索兰克，以及他是如何在又一场英超比赛中隐身的。奥马尔·马尔穆什同样表现平平；先是踢左路，在索兰克被换下后短暂踢了9号位。索兰克一直受到伤病困扰，但在2024年8月以5500万英镑加盟以来，12个联赛进球显然是不够的。大卫·海特纳

比赛报告：托特纳姆热刺 0-0 埃弗顿

水晶宫后卫在周六以3-2失利的惨痛比赛上半场，犯下了在听到哨响前停止比赛的低级错误。这只是皮埃尔·萨奇上任后开始滋生的不良习惯的最新例证。虽然这位法国教练承诺将与Axel Disasi进行谈话，此前他在上半场鲁莽的红牌让水晶宫付出了沉重代价，但听到萨奇说出这番话还是令人惊讶：“我曾和他们讨论过这个问题，因为他们在训练中也做过同样的事情。我告诉他们要继续比赛。因为现在有了VAR，我更希望他们把球解围出底线变成角球，然后再去问裁判是否越位。”在将马克西姆·拉克鲁瓦卖给切尔西后，水晶宫在后防线上缺乏领导力，在前两个主场比赛中已经丢了七个球。萨奇必须在没有Axel Disasi的情况下找到解决防守顽疾的办法，他将因停赛错过接下来的三场英超比赛。埃德·阿伦斯
比赛报告：水晶宫 2-3 伊普斯维奇

切尔西并不真正享受防守的艺术。周六赫尔城的第一粒进球就是明证。古斯托在对抗中被瑞安·吉尔斯压制，而穆罕默德·贝卢米扳平比分则是由于若雷尔·哈托对赫尔城左后卫传中的判断失误。哈维·阿隆索称这太软弱了。切尔西主帅在中场休息时换下了哈托，但问题并非出在某个人身上。作为罗伯特·桑切斯替补引进的埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在门前尚未令人信服。韦斯利·福法纳依然表现虚浮，列维·科尔威尔正在从伤病中逐渐找回状态，而马克西姆·拉克鲁瓦对阵赫尔城时竟然令人意外地坐在替补席上。在阿隆索执教各项赛事的头六场比赛中，切尔西已经丢了12个球。他们依然不够严谨。雅各布·斯坦伯格
比赛报告：切尔西 2-2 赫尔城

奥利弗·格拉斯纳在本赛季开赛前不断提及詹姆斯·麦卡蒂，坚信这位去年夏天以3000万英镑从曼城引进的球员终于能在诺丁汉森林大放异彩。他在周六球队客场战胜阿斯顿维拉取得赛季首胜时的表现，是这名球员重焕新生的又一证据。格拉斯纳坚信这位23岁的球员能够在水晶宫时赋予亚当·沃顿的“四分卫”角色中蓬勃发展。麦卡蒂本赛季首发了全部四场联赛，是上赛季首发次数的两倍；在跨年期间对阵乌得勒支和雷克瑟姆的连续首发中，他在中场休息时就被换下了。但面对维拉，麦卡蒂洋溢着自信，并享受掌控比赛的感觉。在13个月的时间里，格拉斯纳是麦卡蒂在森林队的第五位主帅，但在这位奥地利人手下，他拥有了自己最大的支持者之一。本·费舍尔
比赛报告：阿斯顿维拉 1-2 诺丁汉森林

布伦特福德的维塔利·雅内尔特表示：“许多球队对阵伯恩茅斯时都很艰难。”马尔科·罗泽执教英超以来的所有四个对手都是如此。然而，对首场胜利的等待仍在继续。罗泽说：“如果你看我们的比赛，我认为这是一种享受。”本周，他的球队将飞赴西班牙对阵皇家社会，征战欧联杯，这实现了球迷和俱乐部老板比尔·弗利的梦想。作为足坛的乐观主义者之一，罗泽拒绝将凯文·沙德梅开二度归咎于乔尔杰·彼得罗维奇的门将失误，而是展望了周四的比赛：“对俱乐部来说，这是一场面对顶级对手的特殊之夜。这是一个艰难的球场。顶级的氛围、强硬的对手、一支拥有西班牙国脚的好球队。”伯恩茅斯在欧洲赛场上的生活可能会更容易一些。正如贾斯廷·克鲁伊维特所说：“在这支球队踢球很美妙。我们采取主动进攻、积极逼抢，我们不只是让比赛慢下来，而是全力争取。”约翰·布鲁温
比赛报告：伯恩茅斯 2-2 布伦特福德

bodyEn: A gentleman is never rude unintentionally, only by design. Nobody really knows who said this first. But it could easily be a line from the Elite Football Manager’s Guide to Press Conferences (Premier League edition). Because nothing happens by accident in these spaces.

Every word spoken in front of the board covered in adverts is metered and planned. A manager is never angry, or concerned, or even charming unintentionally. The game is the game, but so are all the other bits spilling out either side of it.

It was hard not to think about this while listening to Mikel Arteta talk about the penalty awarded to Sunderland at the Stadium of Light for a perceived act of grappling on Dan Ballard by Ezri Konsa. This is said with genuine professional respect. As everyone who has ever done a podcast knows – and this is, let’s be clear, everyone – there are lost Amazonian tribes discussing Girls season three in their own dark corner of Spotify – there are moments when you just have to flip the switch, up the energy and turn on full clip‑this‑bit‑up‑please‑Dave sincerity mode.

Arteta did this beautifully in the moment, appearing genuinely struck by what he was saying, radiating wounded integrity, like a disappointed junior headmaster appealing for the return of the school minibus keys.

Let’s be clear though. Arteta is not “very worried” about all this. He’s not “sad” or indeed, as he later emphasised for good measure, “really sad”. He’s not concerned solely with “protecting the game”, speaking here for all of us, just a fan of football.

Come off it. This is a manager we know to be obsessed with the most marginal of gains, to micro-plan the micro-details. As is all elite sport now. There has been talk of rowing coaches installing fibreglass toilet seats at their training hubs having calculated the average athlete spends 20 minutes in there and this is all key glute management time. Arteta loves this stuff. There’s no way Ben White isn’t sat fiddling with his phone at the training ground on a gold-standard Easy‑Cup Mega-Soft Evacu-Throne.

So it is with his public statements. This will have all been gamed and contingency‑planned in advance. And for hard, rational, tactical reasons, because this is how the game is played and run now. So what does it mean?

There are three things we know for sure. First, Arteta was right. This was a bad refereeing decision. Most obviously it was factually wrong. Ballard very skilfully pulled Konsa down on top of him, while simultaneously feigning shock that such a thing could happen.

It was doubly bad because the referee’s response was pre-planned, flagged by the early-season chat about refereeing in a more interventionist fashion. Go into any situation with a voice in your head, a vaguely worded mission to fulfil: this will skew your judgment.

The second thing is that referees are not biased. They’re just not very good. Two things have happened to them. First, the barrage of information to be absorbed in real time during a game is now utterly mind-boggling.

Most referees are not from a high-pressure data-processing background. These are not military pilots or traders on a currency floor. Less than a quarter have an academic degree. The task is beyond them. This is not a slur or an insult. It’s a simple description of what is happening, as supported by the evidence.

This is doubly annoying because referees have become fundamentally confused about their role. Referees are not ringmasters, or curators of the spectacle. They don’t get to decide what our sport should look like. Pro Ref is a private company with no locus standi to rule on the aesthetics of football. A referee should exist at the very edge of the spectacle. You’re not a local government planning officer with a mandate to decide which double-glazed French doors are or aren’t in character with the neighbourhood. Stop getting football not just wrong, but wrong.

But Arteta was also ready for this. Arsenal’s coaches will have known this would happen at some point. That press conference response was already in the chamber. Arteta may even have practised his sad-not-angry face, his key lines.

And this would be the correct thing to do. None of this is breaking the rules, just as Arsenal are not a dirty team or a bunch of cheats. They play the game that is being presented to us, a sport that is being made to operate at the edge of its own ludicrously micro‑analysed rules on small issues of physical contact.

Arteta’s Arsenal have been masterful at finding advantages in this. Defenders are very good at playing with the ball at their feet now. Defenders are not selected for their ability to resist physical challenges. It is logical to exploit this, just as it is logical to seek to protect your ability to do so by speaking in public about how the rules are applied. This is why Arteta is good, and why he wins.

It is also true that this has created a strange environment. The tone of the wider Arsenal fanbase is another element here. There is no one type of football fan. All human life is here. But the fact remains, the loudest voices in the online Arsenal hive mind, even the atmosphere in the stadium is unique in its absolute conviction of victimhood, of conspiracy, of a galvanising sense of adversity.

There is no other ground where every single refereeing decision, even the who-knows 50-50s, is so violently and eloquently disputed. There are supporters who seem to spend most of the game up on their feet in a state of performative, weaponised indignation, whose entire interaction with the spectacle is an attitude of aggrieved injustice.
This makes sense, too. It speaks directly to the game we have created. Aggrieved middle-aged rule pedantry. This is the new cauldron of hate.

Is it based in reality? Not perhaps on the outline numbers. Arsenal have been awarded more fouls than any other team this season. Only six teams last season had more fouls awarded against them, and the same the year before. They had the fewest yellow cards last season. They haven’t had a single red since they had six of them in 2024‑25.

Still, certain key incidents continue to grate and fester. There was the incorrectly denied penalty claim for Bruno Guimarães at Aston Villa. The balls-up with VAR lines against Brentford in 2023, which, if it really was deliberate conspiracy-cheating, was the worst, most public attempt at deliberate conspiracy-cheating ever conceived.

There is discontent at the way some rules seem to be applied more severely to Arsenal, the silly little stuff like delaying or fiddling about with restarts. But then again, if you make the game about that, if you plan to play on the margins, and successfully so, more stuff might happen in that place while you’re doing it.

Arteta has also played the role of arms-length rage conjurer expertly, has gone from rarely commenting on referees to heartfelt and carefully targeted critic. The Sunderland penalty award was a first opportunity to unload on the refereeing backlash to Arsenal’s tactics, to launch his pre-prepared defence; and to point out something demonstrably true. Referees have lost control of this, because the game has got beyond them.

In many ways this was a perfect storm for Arteta. Not just a decision that didn’t matter, because the penalty was saved. But a decision that was clearly incorrect too, a chance to get your lobbying in while very obviously in the right.

There will be more of this as the season plays out, as Arsenal work to preserve the advantages they have made for themselves in close quarters, tactical attack and defence. Factor in that masterful turn at a press conference j’accuse, and Saturday was a significant win in more ways than one.

items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔对裁判判罚的公开批评，正是其精细化管理和战术布局的一部分。
bodyZh: 绅士从不是无意中显得粗鲁，而全都是刻意为之。没有人真正知道这句话是谁最先说的。但这很可能是出自《精英足球主教练新闻发布会指南》（英超版）中的一句台词。因为在这些场合里，没有任何事情是偶然发生的。
在印满赞助商广告的背景板前说的每一个字，都是经过计量和策划的。主教练绝不会无缘无故地生气、担忧，甚至连展现魅力都不是无意的。比赛就是比赛，但在比赛前后的所有花絮同样也是比赛的一部分。
当听到米克尔·阿尔特塔谈到桑德兰在光明球场获得的点球时，人们很难不去想这一点——当时埃兹里·孔萨被认为对丹·巴拉德有拉拽行为。这是出于真正的职业尊重。正如每个做播客的人都知道的那样——说实话，也就是所有人——在Spotify的某个黑暗角落里，总会有一些失落的亚马逊部落在讨论《女孩》第三季；有些时候，你只需按下开关，提升能量，开启全情投入的真诚模式。
阿尔特塔在那一刻将这一点表现得淋漓尽致，他看起来对自己的言论感到由衷的震惊，散发着一种受伤的正直感，就像一个失望的副校长在呼吁归还学校的小巴钥匙。
不过我们要说清楚。阿尔特塔并不是对这一切感到“非常担心”。他并不“难过”，正如他后来特意强调的那样，也并非“真的很难过”。他不仅是为了“保护比赛”而发声，在这里代表我们所有人，他也仅仅是一个足球迷。
得了吧。我们都知道这位主教练痴迷于最微小的优势，对微观细节进行微观规划。现在的顶级体育运动全都是如此。有传言称，赛艇教练在训练基地安装了玻璃纤维马桶座圈，因为他们计算过平均每个运动员在里面呆20分钟，而这全部是关键的臀肌管理时间。阿尔特塔就喜欢这些。本·怀特绝不可能在训练基地的金标易杯超软疏通王宝座上玩手机。
他的公开声明也是如此。这一切都经过了提前的博弈和应急规划。这是出于硬核、理性、战术上的原因，因为现在的比赛就是这样被运作和掌控的。那么这意味着什么呢？
我们有三件事是可以确定的。首先，阿尔特塔是对的。这是一个糟糕的裁判判罚。最显而易见的是，它在事实上是错误的。巴拉德非常巧妙地把孔萨拉倒在自己身上，同时还假装对这种事情的发生感到震惊。
这个判罚之所以糟糕，还因为裁判的反应是预先策划好的，赛季初关于以更具干涉主义的方式进行判罚的讨论就给出了信号。带着某种既定想法进入任何情境，去完成一项措辞模糊的使命：这会扭曲你的判断。
第二件事是，裁判并不是带有偏见。他们只是水平不够高。他们身上发生了两件事。首先，在比赛期间实时需要吸收的信息量简直令人匪夷所思。
大多数裁判并非出身于高压数据处理背景。他们不是军用飞行员，也不是外汇交易员。不到四分之一的人拥有大学学位。这项任务超出了他们的能力。这不是诋毁或侮辱。这是对正在发生的事情的简单描述，并且有证据支持。
这之所以加倍令人恼火，是因为裁判们对自己的角色产生了根本性的混淆。裁判不是马戏团团长，也不是奇观的策展人。他们无权决定我们的足球运动应该是什么样子。职业裁判公司是一家私人公司，没有法定地位来裁决足球的美学。裁判应该存在于奇观的最边缘。你不是地方政府规划官员，没有授权去决定哪些双层玻璃法式门才符合社区的风格。别再把足球搞砸了，而且是错得离谱。
但阿尔特塔对此也做好了准备。阿森纳的教练们会知道这种情况迟早会发生。新闻发布会上那番回应已经在酝酿之中了。阿尔特塔甚至可能练习过他那种难过但不生气的表情以及他的核心台词。
而这将会是正确的做法。这些都没有违反规则，就像阿森纳不是一支粗野的球队或是一群骗子一样。他们只是在按照现有的规则踢球，这项运动目前正被逼在自身极其微观分析的规则边缘运行，处理的只是一些关于身体接触的小问题。
阿尔特塔的阿森纳在寻找这方面的优势时堪称大师。现在的后卫非常擅长用脚控球。挑选后卫并不是为了让他们具备抵抗身体对抗的能力。利用这一点是合乎逻辑的，正如通过公开谈论规则如何应用来保护自己利用这一点的能力也是合乎逻辑的一样。这就是为什么阿尔特塔很优秀，也是为什么他能赢。

同样真实的是，这创造了一种奇怪的环境。更广泛的阿森纳球迷群体的基调也是这里的另一个因素。没有哪一种单一类型的足球球迷。所有人都在这里。但事实依然是，阿森纳网络群体中最嘈杂的声音，甚至球场内的氛围，在其对受害者心态、阴谋论以及一种激昂的逆境感的绝对确信上，都是独一无二的。
没有哪个球场像这里一样，每一个裁判判罚，甚至是那些未知的五五开判罚，都会遭到如此激烈和雄辩的质疑。有些支持者似乎在比赛的大部分时间里都站着，处于一种表演式的、武器化的愤慨状态中，他们与比赛的全部互动都带着一种受委屈的不满态度。
这也说得通。它直接呼应了我们所创造的比赛。满腹牢骚的中年规则学究。这就是仇恨的新大熔炉。
这有现实依据吗？也许从表面数据来看并没有。本赛季阿森纳被判的犯规次数比其他任何球队都多。上赛季只有六支球队被判的犯规次数比他们多，前一年也是如此。他们上赛季得到的黄牌最少。自从在2024-25赛季吃到六张红牌以来，他们还没有拿过一张红牌。
尽管如此，某些关键事件继续让人感到烦心和发酵。在阿斯顿维拉对阵布鲁诺·吉马良斯的比赛中，本该判给他们的点球被错误地剥夺了。2023年对阵布伦特福德时VAR划线的乌龙事件——如果这真的是蓄意作弊的阴谋，那将是有史以来策划最糟糕、最公开的蓄意阴谋作弊。
人们对某些规则似乎对阿森纳执行得更严厉感到不满，比如拖延时间或在重新开球时搞小动作等这些愚蠢的小事。话又说回来，如果你把比赛的重点放在那上面，如果你计划在边缘地带踢球并取得了成功，那么当你这样做的时候，那个地方可能会发生更多的事情。
阿尔特塔也非常熟练地扮演了远程愤怒操纵者的角色，从很少对裁判发表评论转变为进行真诚且目标明确的批评。判给桑德兰的点球是第一次机会，让他得以宣泄对阿森纳战术的裁判反弹，发起他事先准备好的辩护，并指出一个显而易见的事实：裁判已经失去了对局面的控制，因为比赛已经超出了他们的掌控。
在许多方面，这对阿尔特塔来说是一场完美的风暴。不仅是一个无关紧要的判罚（因为点球被扑出了），而且是一个明显不正确的判罚，这是一个在自己显然占理时进行游说的机会。
随着赛季的进行，这种情况还会更多，因为阿森纳正努力保持他们在近距离战术攻防中为自己赢得的优势。考虑到在新闻发布会上那次大师级的指控，周六的这场胜利在不止一个方面具有重大意义。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta’s delight at Arsenal’s latest win was tempered by his fury with the referee John Brooks as the champions triumphed 2-0 at Sunderland on Saturday night.

Before Bruno Guimarães gave Arsenal the lead in a tight match that Régis Le Bris’s team were arguably unlucky to lose, David Raya made a brilliant save to deny Enzo Le Fée from the penalty spot. Arteta, however, did not believe that Ezri Konsa had hauled Dan Ballard to the ground, instead blaming the Sunderland man for pulling down his opponent.

“We had to overcome a really tough opponent in a difficult place,” said Arsenal’s manager. “Sunderland can suffocate you and they decided to be really physical and very direct and we also had to overcome a situation that, in my opinion was unacceptable at this level.

“I’m very worried and sad because this can never be a penalty. It’s a judo roll from the opponent. Ezri does nothing. We have to take responsibility to protect the game. Today the game was unprotected and it could have cost us the win and our momentum. I’m really sad. It should never have happened.”

Arteta, who was booked in the first half for persistently stepping out of his technical area, hailed Guimarães’s goal as “beautiful” after watching Bukayo Saka scored a second goal from the penalty spot in stoppage time, when Sunderland’s Reinildo was sent off for a second bookable offence.

Le Bris was left with mixed feelings. “I’m proud and disappointed, these are the two words that are in my mind at the minute,” said Sunderland’s manager. “I’m proud because I think we showed that we are really close to achieving something big against one of the best teams in Europe right now. After the first half we were a bit reserved with the ball I think, but our second half was excellent.
“We got the momentum, created chances and it was a big save from Raya from the penalty. I think it was very good goalkeeping rather than a poor penalty. Raya was absolutely impressive today.
“We stayed in the game and we created other chances but we didn’t score and that was the difference today.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔对客场战胜桑德兰比赛中的点球判罚感到愤怒，并认为裁判的决定不可接受。
bodyZh: 周六晚上，在阿森纳客场2-0战胜桑德兰后，主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔虽然为球队的最新胜利感到高兴，但也难掩他对裁判约翰·布鲁克斯的愤怒。
在吉马良斯为阿森纳打破僵局之前，大卫·拉亚神勇扑出了恩佐·勒费埃主罚的点球。然而，阿尔特塔并不认为埃兹里·孔萨将丹·巴拉德拉倒在地，反而指责是桑德兰球员拉倒了他的队员。
阿森纳主帅说：“我们必须在一个艰难的地方克服一个非常强大的对手。桑德兰能让你感到窒息，他们踢得很具身体对抗性且非常直接，而且我们还必须克服一个在我看来在这个水平上不可接受的情况。”
“我感到非常担忧和难过，因为这绝不可能是点球。这是对手的柔道式翻滚。埃兹里什么都没做。我们必须承担起保护比赛的责任。今天比赛没有受到保护，这本可能让我们付出胜利和势头的代价。我真的很伤心。这绝不应该发生。”
上半场因持续离开技术区域而被黄牌警告的阿尔特塔盛赞吉马良斯的进球“非常漂亮”，随后萨卡在补时阶段通过点球攻入第二球，当时桑德兰的雷尼尔多因累计两张黄牌被罚下。
勒布里斯则百感交集。桑德兰主帅说：“我现在脑海里有两个词，那就是骄傲和失望。我感到骄傲，是因为我认为我们证明了自己非常有希望在面对欧洲最强球队之一时取得重大成就。上半场我们在控球时有点保守，但下半场我们表现得非常出色。”
“我们占据了势头，创造了机会，而拉亚扑出了那个点球是一次伟大的扑救。我认为这是非常出色的守门表现，而不是点球罚得差。拉亚今天的表现绝对令人印象深刻。”
“我们留在了比赛中，也创造了其他机会，但我们没有进球，这就是今天的差距。”

bodyEn: Our under-21s scored a late equaliser to draw 2-2 with Premier League 2 champions Brighton on Saturday night.
Having taken the lead through a brilliant finish from debutant James Scanlon, we trailed entering the final stages of the game to goals from Younes Ibrahim and Bailey Palmer.
But substitutes Louis Zecevic-John and Evan Mooney combined late on, with Zecevic-John setting up Mooney to equalise in the 88th-minute of the contest.

bodyZh: 周六晚，我们的U21青年队在英超2级联赛中以2-2战平冠军布莱顿，我们在比赛尾声阶段打入绝平进球。
